@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Henry cast a g______e at the letter on the table but decided not to open it yet.
= glance
~詞義 glance（n.）一瞥
~原文 Henry cast a glance at the letter on the table but decided not to open it yet.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: There are still many unknown plant and animal species in tropical j______es.
= jungles
~詞義 jungle（n.）叢林
~原文 There are still many unknown plant and animal species in tropical jungles.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Since all the hotels were fully booked, we had no choice but to stay at a small i______n.
= inn
~詞義 inn（n.）小旅館
~原文 Since all the hotels were fully booked, we had no choice but to stay at a small inn.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: We gave Chrissy the n______e "Cutie" because she looks really cute.
= nickname
~詞義 nickname（n.）綽號
~原文 We gave Chrissy the nickname "Cutie" because she looks really cute.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: My mother always separates white clothes from colored ones when she does the l______y.
= laundry
~詞義 laundry（n.）待洗的衣服
~原文 My mother always separates white clothes from colored ones when she does the laundry.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Be careful with your ______ when you're in a foreign country because they may have different meanings there.
A: barrels
B: gestures
C: marbles
D: alleys
= B
~詞義 gesture（n.）手勢
~原文 Be careful with your gestures when you're in a foreign country because they may have different meanings there.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The duck laid eight eggs, and they ______ twelve days later.
A: loosened
B: assisted
C: hatched
D: grabbed
= C
~詞義 hatch（v.）孵化
~原文 The duck laid eight eggs, and they hatched twelve days later.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: There will be a book fair next week, and my favorite ______ will be there.
A: alley
B: harbor
C: outline
D: novelist
= D
~詞義 novelist（n.）小說家
~原文 There will be a book fair next week, and my favorite novelist will be there.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: I think there is a hole in the pipe under the sink. I can hear water ______ from it.
A: grabbing
B: hatching
C: leaking
D: assisting
= C
~詞義 leak（v.）漏水
~原文 I think there is a hole in the pipe under the sink. I can hear water leaking from it.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The castle's floor is paved with white ______. It is smooth and shiny.
A: marble
B: barrel
C: cattle
D: valley
= A
~詞義 marble（n.）大理石
~原文 The castle's floor is paved with white marble. It is smooth and shiny.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: loose
B: kit
C: barrel
D: forever
E: grab
F: fake

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: I noticed that my tooth felt a little bit ______; a few weeks later, it fell out.
= A
~詞義 loose（adj.）鬆的
~原文 I noticed that my tooth felt a little bit loose; a few weeks later, it fell out.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The coach always carries a first-aid ______ to treat minor cuts or sprains during practice.
= B
~詞義 kit（n.）急救箱(first-aid kit)
~原文 The coach always carries a first-aid kit to treat minor cuts or sprains during practice.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Waiting for the results felt like it took ______, though it had only been a few minutes.
= D
~詞義 forever（adv.）永遠
~原文 Waiting for the results felt like it took forever, though it had only been a few minutes.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Those earrings look expensive, but the stones on them are actually ______.
= F
~詞義 fake（adj.）假的
~原文 Those earrings look expensive, but the stones on them are actually fake.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: When an opportunity appears, you must ______ it, for it may never come again.
= E
~詞義 grab（v.）利用(機會)
~原文 When an opportunity appears, you must grab it, for it may never come again.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: assistance
B: joyful
C: alley
D: spite
E: outline
F: ambitious

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: With some financial ______ from the government, Bill was finally able to start his own business.
= A
~詞義 assistance（n.）援助
~原文 With some financial assistance from the government, Bill was finally able to start his own business.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Patty is a(n) ______ woman. She wants to expand her fashion business internationally.
= F
~詞義 ambitious（adj.）有野心的
~原文 Patty is a(n) ambitious woman. She wants to expand her fashion business internationally.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: In ______ of the heavy rain, the runners continued the marathon with remarkable determination.
= D
~詞義 spite（n.）儘管(in spite of)
~原文 In spite of the heavy rain, the runners continued the marathon with remarkable determination.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: To begin, the speaker showed a(n) ______ of his presentation to the audience.
= E
~詞義 outline（n.）大綱
~原文 To begin, the speaker showed a(n) outline of his presentation to the audience.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The dark and narrow ______ between the houses leads to the main street.
= C
~詞義 alley（n.）小巷
~原文 The dark and narrow alley between the houses leads to the main street.
